classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding nature-themed magic and shapeshifting.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: A master of martial combat, skilled with weapons and armor.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body and mind.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath of justice and devotion.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: A stealthy trickster who excels at skills, stealth, and striking from the shadows.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: A spellcaster who draws power from a pact with a powerful entity.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A scholarly spellcaster who wields magic through study and arcane knowledge.
